name: md-deck
description: Write and version Reveal.js presentations in Markdown, export them as PDF
author: Knab Florian

scripts.export:pdf: DECK_NORM="${DECK#../}"; DECK_NORM="${DECK_NORM%.md}"; DECK_NORM="${DECK_NORM:-slides/template}"; npx decktape reveal --size 1680x945 "http://localhost:5173/?md=../$DECK_NORM.md" "../$DECK_NORM.pdf" && node scripts/pdf-bookmarks.js "../$DECK_NORM.md" "../$DECK_NORM.pdf"
